_comment: Single source of truth for every live address. Read at BUILD TIME by the apps that link to each other, and checked against DEPLOYMENTS.md in CI. Never read at runtime: an address that can come from the URL lets a crafted link show attacker data under a genuine address (WHITEPAPER.md §15). `superseded` is the migration lineage, newest first: the instance ids a carry-forward probe GETs to recover state stranded by a re-key. Appended automatically by the publish scripts — a generation missing here cannot be migrated from. `delegate.superseded` lets the vault find an identity stranded by a delegate re-key: freenet-core retains delegate WASM indefinitely, so an older generation the node once registered is still addressable by its key — nothing needs to be re-shipped.
